**The fifth release candidate.** It ships inside [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.4](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.4) and needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer. The new Ioniq 6 USA 260507 and Elantra N maps come with HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.4, so on those cars update HMG-API too.

## What's new since 2.2.0-rc.4

- **More cars:**
  - Ioniq 6 (`CEEV`) on USA 260507 (#51, thanks to SafariForest)
  - Ioniq 6 on USA 260903 (#58, thanks to ianpf)
  - Ioniq 6 on Canada 260903 (#53, thanks to joshuaauger)
  - Ioniq 5 `NEEV23SE` on US 260507 and 260903 (#54, thanks to lemoyneiv)
  - Sportage Hybrid (`NQ5HEV`) on US 260507 (#60, thanks to Mantene)
  - Elantra N (`CN7NPE`) on US 260903 (#62, thanks to drtaru)
- **Allow wireless CarPlay through the hotspot firewall** (new setting, off by default). Some cars' stock firewalls allow CarPlay's ports only over the cable, so the iPhone finds the car and then gets dropped. This setting lets CarPlay's ports, mDNS and ICMPv6 through from the hotspot only, and HMG-API removes the rules when it's turned off. Turn it on on the US Ioniq 6 and the Elantra N (#51, #62).
- **Song, artist and album art on wireless CarPlay** (new setting, on by default). The car only asked the phone for Now Playing over the cable; it now asks again once wireless CarPlay is up (#51).
- **Turn-by-turn on the cluster stays after the iAP2 handover.** CarPlay's sends get one thread per link, a lost link is re-attached with a backoff, and route guidance is asked for again once it's back (#51).
- **CarPlay turns in the car's own format** (hwjang1, #33). **Turns in the car's own format** (`tbt_standard`, off by default) now covers CarPlay as well as Android Auto, so the AR HUD animates CarPlay's turns too. Checked on a Korean EV6 with the AR HUD.
- **Android Auto on-ramps in the car's own format** (AwsomeFox, #30): with that setting on, on-ramps go out as the car's own turn, which the AR HUD animates, instead of the projection icon.
- **CarPlay audio** (lemoyneiv, #55): music and Siri starting at the same moment no longer race while loading the codecs, and an audio format the CarPlay library sometimes sends (16-bit PCM written as "0 bits") is accepted.
- The NEMESIS package now refuses to install alongside `enhanced.projection` (#54).

## What to test

- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto still start** on cars where they worked with rc.4, with music, a call and turn-by-turn.
- **On the US Ioniq 6 260507 and the Elantra N:** turn on **Allow wireless CarPlay through the hotspot firewall**, save, apply, then connect wirelessly. Check that Now Playing shows on the cluster.
- **With an AR HUD and Turns in the car's own format:** forks, highway exits, roundabouts and arrival on CarPlay; on-ramps on Android Auto. Only turns and U-turns are confirmed on a drive so far.
- **The cluster's turn-by-turn after a long drive with CarPlay:** does it keep coming back after a dropout?

## Known issues

- The cluster's route-guidance watchdog (#51) is still being confirmed on a drive.
- Bluetooth Audio can grab focus at a cold start before CarPlay or Android Auto is up; a fix is in review (#56).
- The Palisade on US 260507 isn't in the car list yet; it waits for its HMG-API map (#49).

## Going back

To 2.2.0-rc.4: remove the mod in the HMG-API app and apply. Then put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.4.zip` (from [its release](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.4)) in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick and use Check USB updates. Over adb, `hmgapid engine install <zip> --force` installs it directly.

## Reporting

Open an [issue here](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose). Include your car, its head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version, this mod's version and your phone, plus a Car Report from the HMG-API app if you can.
